orgName.title: Organization name
orgName.description: Shown in the panel header and Settings so users know settings are managed.

supportUrl.title: Support URL
supportUrl.description: Link shown in Settings for help with AEP AI Center.

backendUrl.title: Backend URL
backendUrl.description: URL of your organization's AEP AI Center backend, e.g. https://aep-ai.example.internal

backendToken.title: Backend API token
backendToken.description: Value of API_TOKEN configured on the backend.

followPageSandbox.title: Follow the sandbox open in AEP

provider.title: LLM provider
provider.description: anthropic, openai (OpenAI-compatible incl. Azure OpenAI) or gemini

baseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL
baseUrl.description: For Azure OpenAI or a self-hosted gateway.

apiKey.title: LLM API key
apiKey.description: Optional. Leave unset to let users bring their own key.

disableAi.title: Turn off AI features
disableAi.description: Keeps Explore, audit, linting and Context; hides LLM features.
